title: Crash when piping file into external programm
body:
<!-- Your issue may already be reported!
Please search on the issue tracker before creating one. -->

### Reproduction steps

Open https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raiden-network/scenario-player/master/README.rst
Select all (`%`), pipe it to a shell command (`|`), run `rg oo`.
